entries.title: Ico
entries.definitive_edition: The Ico & Shadow of the Colossus Collection HD remaster

emulation.emulator: Native PS3; RPCS3 for owned PS3 copies
emulation.notes: Use the PS3 collection for official play. RPCS3 is a preservation route for owned copies.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: PS3 HD remaster at up to 1080p with fixed 30 FPS target and 7.1 surround support.

primary.version: The Ico & Shadow of the Colossus Collection HD remaster
primary.why: The PS3 HD remaster is the best version because it supports HD displays up to 1080p, a fixed 30 FPS target, 7.1 surround sound, stereoscopic 3D, trophies, and the additional European-version Ico content that was missing from the original North American PS2 release.
primary.how_to_play: Play Ico through The Ico & Shadow of the Colossus Collection on PS3.

entries.remaster_caveats: This is an HD remaster of the PS2 game, not a remake; no native PS4/PS5/PC version was identified.

entries.title: Shadow of the Colossus

emulation.emulator: Native PS4 / PS5 backward compatibility; PCSX2 or RPCS3 for original/remaster comparison
emulation.notes: Use the 2018 remake for normal play. Use PS2 or PS3 versions only for historical comparison.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: PS4 remake presentation, with PS5 backward compatibility as the cleanest current console route.

primary.why: The 2018 PS4 remake is the definitive version for best-version play because Bluepoint remade the visual assets from the ground up while retaining the original game's structure and adding a modern control option.
primary.how_to_play: Play the 2018 Shadow of the Colossus remake on PS4, or on PS5 through backward compatibility.

entries.remaster_caveats: This is a full visual remake of the 2005 game, not a new sequel or reboot; the PS3 HD remaster is the closer preservation version.

entries.title: The Last Guardian
entries.definitive_edition: Fully patched PS4 version on PS5 backward compatibility or PS4 Pro

emulation.notes: Use the fully updated PS4 version on PS5 or PS4 Pro for normal play. Avoid the unpatched 60 FPS route unless you are deliberately testing performance behavior.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Fully patched PS4 Pro/PS5-backward-compatible presentation; unpatched PS5 disc can run at 60 FPS but is caveated.

primary.version: Fully patched PS4 version on PS5 or PS4 Pro
primary.why: The fully patched PS4 version played on PS5 through backward compatibility, or on PS4 Pro, is the safest best-version route because it preserves the complete patched game with the Pro-era HDR/4K support while avoiding the instability caveats of the unpatched-disc 60 FPS path.
primary.how_to_play: Play the updated PS4 version on PS5 through backward compatibility, or on PS4 Pro. Use the unpatched-disc 60 FPS route only as a technical curiosity, not for a first complete playthrough.

entries.remaster_caveats: No native PS5 or PC remaster was identified; the 60 FPS PS5 route depends on an unpatched disc and is not the recommended complete-playthrough version.
